interpretation_contract.numeric_comparison: Decimal comparisons; explicit inclusive/exclusive bounds; never round before classification.
interpretation_contract.inequality_policy: Assign a category only when the entire possible result interval belongs to it. Otherwise retain category range or unknown; never replace > or >= with equality.
interpretation_contract.unit_policy: Compare only matching/verified-convertible units. Missing unit is unknown, not automatically dimensionless.
interpretation_contract.personal_overrides: Affect selected personal display rules; do not erase original laboratory flags or independently applicable critical alerts.
interpretation_contract.year_policy: Use source-effective versions;2026 verification date does not make older publications2026 editions. Preserve old reference context when recoloring under a selected current profile.
interpretation_contract.critical_policy: Preserve source flags independently. Enable explicitly named, unconditioned Taipei VGH application-alert templates with specimen/unit guards; conditional age, outpatient, specialty and unspecified blood-gas thresholds remain inactive.
interpretation_contract.unknown_policy: Gray. No invented numeric cutoff or default-safe classification.

settings_storage_contract.database: SQLite by default; optional MySQL. SQL stores whitelisted settings only, not health observations.
settings_storage_contract.identity_requirement: Generate only after successful official authentication; never trust an unverified submitted ID. Same verified subject and stable key map to same settings on phone/desktop.
settings_storage_contract.identity_caveat: Pseudonymous linkage, not complete anonymity. Store key version; protect/back up the server secret outside the database.
settings_storage_contract.browser_login_memory: Earlier requested device-local login-field memory is separate from server configuration storage; it contains identity information and must be optional/clearable. If no browser PII retention is intended, disable it and rely on password-manager/user entry.
settings_storage_contract.browser_report_storage: Medical data stays in memory by default. Explicit opt-in for the currently verified profile permits a bounded device-local IndexedDB cache with separate consent and clear controls. Report localStorage and service-worker caching remain prohibited; authenticated HTTP responses use no-store. Restored cached data is labelled as historical cache provenance, not a new official acquisition or current completeness proof.
settings_storage_contract.configuration_creation: Expose all built-in measurement settings before import; add genuinely observed unknown measurements only, excluding missing/metadata. Deduplicate verified configuration keys and preserve separate source channels. Built-in definitions are not copied into each SQL document. Reset removes overrides; it does not freeze current defaults into personal settings.
settings_storage_contract.concurrency: One profile_settings row per pseudonymous subject_key stores whitelisted settings JSON, revision and updated_at. Writes and deletion use expected-revision comparison; individual configuration overrides are fields within that document, not separate SQL rows.
settings_storage_contract.retention_consequence: After session end, observations can be recovered only from a still-available official source or an explicitly retained user download/device cache. Neither local recovery nor an old source snapshot establishes current official completeness, and the server settings database cannot reconstruct observations.
